title: The Wild Wolf
author: Bram Nakamura
blurb: Noor Kavanagh, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
